question: In February 2012, what percentage of customers consumed more than 528.3?

details.reason: Complete results differ from Gold SQL; BIRD Soft F1 = 0.0
details.actual_sql:
WITH feb_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id, consumption
  FROM yearmonth
  WHERE date = '201202'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
  ) AS pct_customers_above_threshold
FROM feb_customers;
details.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(customer_id), 0) FROM yearmonth WHERE date = '201202'
